question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Languid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Languid"** means lacking in vigor or vitality; slack or slow. (सुस्त)

 
 
• **Example:** After the long hike, she felt **languid **and just wanted to lie down.
 
 
 
• **"Energetic"** refers to having or showing a lot of energy. (ऊर्जावान)
 
 
• **Example:** The children were **energetic** and played outside all afternoon.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Languid'** is **'Energetic'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exceptional** (असाधारण): Unusual; not typical.

 
 
• **Example:** She has an exceptional talent for music.
 
 
 
• **Lazy** (आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.
 
 
• **Example:** He is too lazy to clean his room.
 
 
 
• **Loyal** (वफादार): Giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance.
 
 
• **Example:** The dog was loyal to its owner.
